note: For petrol: petrol haaksu (kn), petrol daalo (hi), petrol podu (ta), petrol adikkuka (ml).
In Chennai you also hear sign podunga.
For a parcel people also just say take it: togo, le lo, vaangu, vaanguka.
Indians say xerox. In Chennai and Kochi you take a xerox: xerox edu, xerox edukkuka.
Everyone uses the noun: complaint maadi, complaint kijiye, complaint pannunga, complaint cheyyoo.
To an auto driver: left-ge tirugi, left mudiye, left-la thirumbunga, idathottu thiriyoo.
Drop someone off: station-ge drop maadi.
Delhi says pick karna, Kochi says pick cheyyuka.
Bangalore and Chennai say reach aagu: reach aade, reach aayitten. The proper Kannada word is talupu. Delhi often says pahunch gaya.
a bus, an auto, a train
a bus or train. For a car or an auto, Delhi just says baitho (sit).
a phone. Chennai puts it on charge: charge podu.
money. Most people now just say GPay maadi, GPay kar do, GPay pannunga.
With money as the object most people say take out: duddu tegi, paise nikaalo, panam edu, paisa edukk.
Hindi says jama karna: paise jama karo.
Give it back to me is thirichu thaa in Malayalam. A shop return is return maadi, return kijiye, return pannunga.
saala, udhaar, kadan and kadam all mean a loan. For a pen or a book people just ask: kodi, de do, kudunga, tharoo.
money. For time everyone says time spend maadu, karna, pannu, cheyyuka.
money
Just say on: fan on maadi, fan on karo, fan on pannunga, fan on aakkoo.
Delhi also says band karo for a light or a fan.
clothes. Delhi says press karna. The iron man on the street is the istriwala.
Indians say shift: mane shift maadide, ghar shift kiya, veedu shift pannom.
Hindi milna takes se: main usse milta hoon.
bulaana and koopdu also mean call someone over. kshanikkuka is for weddings and functions.
The everyday line puts I in the to-form: nanage artha aaytu, mujhe samajh aaya, enakku puriyudhu, enikku manassilaayi.
Also said with I in the to-form: nanage maretoytu, enakku marandhu pochu, enikku marannu poyi. Delhi says main bhool gaya.
a thing. Often said as it got lost: phone kaltu hoytu, phone kho gaya, phone tholanjiduchu, phone poyi.
a class, a company. Bangalore says join aagu: naanu company-ge join aade.
Tamil uses the same word for read and study (padi); Malayalam the same word for learn and study (padikkuka).
At a restaurant say parcel: parcel kodi, parcel kar dijiye, parcel pannunga, parcel tharoo.
kumbidu is folding your hands before God. Delhi also says dua karna; Chennai churches say jebam pannu.
a festival, a birthday: Diwali manaate hain, Deepavali kondaaduvom, Onam aaghoshichu.
on stage
water, milk. For milk Bangalore also says haalu kaayisu.
get up in the morning. Hindi uthna is both wake up and get up.
Everyone says ready. Delhi: ready ho jaao.
